"I would rather sell it. Are you interested?"

Entries.Text: "I cannot part with it. Could you hold it for me against a loan?"

Entries.Source: “我急用钱，但还想赎回来。能押在这儿吗？”
Entries.Text: "I need cash, but I want this back. Can I leave it as security?"
"Useful. I will keep it in the collection."
"Thanks. I will keep it for now."

Entries.Source: “镀的？没人跟我说过……”顾客移开了目光。

Entries.Text: "That was there when I got it. Probably."
"I had wondered about that. Go on."

Entries.Source: “严重吗？我只想知道它值多少。”
Entries.Text: "Is it bad? I just need to know what it is worth."

Entries.Source: “不是足金？我可是按足金买的……”
Entries.Text: "It is not solid? I paid for solid gold..."

There is no stone in this setting.

Entries.Text: The laboratory only identifies loose or mounted stones.

Entries.Text: This stone already has a current report.

Entries.Text: The order needs a price and a deadline after today.

Entries.Source: 这件首饰还没做好，不能交付。
Entries.Text: The piece is not ready to hand over.

Entries.Text: Collect the bench work before cancelling.

点击物品上看得见的瑕疵。发现会自动计入对应的价格部分。

Entries.Text: The item now uses its full size.

Entries.Source: 空间还是不够。腾出位置后再试。
Entries.Text: Still not enough room. Free some space and try again.

Entries.Source: 肉眼：结构损伤、缺口和缺件不用仪器就能看到。对照完好图的同一位置。
Entries.Text: Eye: structural damage, chips and missing parts are visible without tools. Compare with the intact picture at the same spot.

Entries.Source: 放大镜：看细划痕、焊缝和印记边缘；它看不出金属成分。
Entries.Text: Loupe: shows fine scratches, solder seams and stamp edges. It does not tell you what the metal is.

Entries.Source: 成色分析仪：测出金属成分。露出异色底材时，先测再估金价。
Entries.Text: Assay: measures the metal. Test before you value gold that shows a different-coloured base.

Entries.Source: 电子秤：比较实重与声称重量；重量本身证明不了成色。
Entries.Text: Scale: compares the real weight with the claim. Weight alone does not prove purity.

Entries.Source: 紫外灯：帮助发现填充、染色和修补边界。有无荧光都不能单独作证。
Entries.Text: UV lamp: helps find fills, dye and restoration edges. A glow, or no glow, is not proof by itself.

Entries.Source: 透玉灯：照出开窗内的棉絮和裂隙；照不透未开的皮壳。
Entries.Text: Jade light: shows cotton and cracks inside an open window. It cannot read a closed skin.

Entries.Source: 实验室报告：唯一能确定宝石来源或处理的依据。筛查笔只能提示“建议送检”。
Entries.Text: Laboratory report: the only way to establish a stone's origin or treatment. A probe can only say 'refer for testing'.

Entries.Source: 宝石筛查笔：筛出明显仿制品；通过不代表天然。
Entries.Text: Gem probe: screens for obvious substitutes. Passing does not confirm natural origin.

Entries.Source: 计价：金属价值 = 重量 × 实测成色 × 当日价。划痕、凹陷和旧修只扣工艺价。例：金 600 + 工艺 200 = 800；一道划痕扣 40，剩 760。
Entries.Text: Pricing: metal value = weight x tested purity x today's rate. Scratches, dents and repairs only reduce workmanship. Example: gold 600 + workmanship 200 = 800; a scratch -40 leaves 760.

Entries.Source: 计价：豆、糯、冰定档；裂和棉降低品相。未开窗的原石按平均档估价。
Entries.Text: Pricing: the tier (dou, nuo, bing) sets the band; cracks and cotton lower condition. A closed skin is priced at the average band until opened.

Entries.Source: 计价：镶座金属 + 工艺 + 每颗真实宝石分别计算。缺一颗石只少这颗石的价。
Entries.Text: Pricing: setting metal + workmanship + each real stone, valued separately. A missing stone removes that stone's value only.

Entries.Source: 计价：物料按含量和当日价计算。回收前先比较维修转卖。
Entries.Text: Pricing: a lot is worth what it holds at today's rate. Compare repair and resale before recovery.

Entries.Source: 计价：修补和重刻只去掉收藏溢价，器物本身仍有价值。
Entries.Text: Pricing: restoration and recut marks remove the collector premium, not the object itself.

Entries.Source: 计价：印刷网点和印章不符去掉溢价；撕裂和水渍降低品相。
Entries.Text: Pricing: print screens and seal mismatches remove the premium; tears and water damage lower condition.

Entries.Source: 计价：能否正常使用决定转卖价；可回收金属是另一条更低的底线。
Entries.Text: Pricing: working condition sets the resale price; recoverable metal is a separate, smaller floor.

Entries.Source: 计价：版本标记决定溢价；划伤降低品相。
Entries.Text: Pricing: edition marks set the premium; scratches lower condition.

Entries.Source: 计价：初版和真签名才有溢价；重印本只剩阅读价值。
Entries.Text: Pricing: first editions and real signatures carry the premium; reprints keep only the reading value.
